description: eeg-skill 统筹已登记的独立方法和可复用流程。支持：EEG/MEG 数据检查；MNE LOF 坏导联检测与插值；EEG/MEG 滤波与降采样；MNE ICA 分解与指定成分去除；重参考与分段；Epoch AutoReject 自动质控；传感器 PLV/相干/wPLI；Morlet 时频功率与 ITC；其他方法可在详情中分页查询。

method_refs.label: EEG/MEG 数据检查
method_refs.role: Read a supported continuous EEG/MEG recording, reject non-finite data, report channel/sample counts and sampling frequency, and save the recording as FIF。 Inputs: input: EEG/MEG 原始文件（FIF/EDF/BDF/SET） (file). Registered outputs: results/processed-raw.fif. Fixed invocation options: --operation inspect.

method_refs.label: MNE LOF 坏导联检测与插值
method_refs.role: Detect EEG bad channels using MNE local-outlier-factor detection and interpolate them using channel positions; retain the detected-channel list in the summary。 Inputs: input: EEG/MEG 原始文件（FIF/EDF/BDF/SET） (file). Registered outputs: results/processed-raw.fif. Fixed invocation options: --operation bad-channels.

method_refs.label: EEG/MEG 滤波与降采样
method_refs.role: Apply MNE IIR band-pass filtering, optional notch filtering and optional downsampling to continuous data; validate cutoffs against the original and requested Nyquist frequencies。 Inputs: input: EEG/MEG 原始文件（FIF/EDF/BDF/SET） (file). Registered outputs: results/processed-raw.fif. Fixed invocation options: --operation filter.

method_refs.label: MNE ICA 分解与指定成分去除
method_refs.role: Fit MNE ICA on a high-pass-filtered copy, identify EOG/ECG-related components when corresponding channels exist, combine explicit exclusions and apply the fitted cleaning to the recording。 Inputs: input: EEG/MEG 原始文件（FIF/EDF/BDF/SET） (file). Registered outputs: results/processed-raw.fif. Fixed invocation options: --operation ica.

method_refs.label: 重参考与分段
method_refs.role: Create MNE epochs from supplied events and time limits, or fixed-duration epochs when events are absent; apply average EEG referencing and save accepted epochs as FIF。 Inputs: input: EEG/MEG 原始文件（FIF/EDF/BDF/SET） (file); events: MNE 事件文件 (file). Registered outputs: results/processed-epo.fif. Fixed invocation options: --operation epoch.

method_refs.label: Epoch AutoReject 自动质控
method_refs.role: Create epochs and run AutoReject with cross-validation to repair/reject contaminated epochs. At least four epochs and valid sensor positions are required。 Inputs: input: EEG/MEG 原始文件（FIF/EDF/BDF/SET） (file); events: MNE 事件文件 (file). Registered outputs: results/processed-epo.fif. Fixed invocation options: --operation autoreject.

method_refs.label: 传感器 PLV/相干/wPLI
method_refs.role: Create epochs and compute spectral PLV, coherence and wPLI in the requested frequency band using mne-connectivity; export matrices and channel names in NPZ。 Inputs: input: EEG/MEG 原始文件（FIF/EDF/BDF/SET） (file); events: MNE 事件文件 (file). Registered outputs: results/connectivity.npz. Fixed invocation options: --operation connectivity.

method_refs.label: Morlet 时频功率与 ITC
method_refs.role: Compute averaged Morlet time-frequency power and inter-trial coherence from epochs at twelve frequencies spanning the selected band; export power, ITC, frequencies and times。 Inputs: input: EEG/MEG 原始文件（FIF/EDF/BDF/SET） (file); events: MNE 事件文件 (file). Registered outputs: results/time_frequency.npz. Fixed invocation options: --operation time-frequency.

method_refs.label: MEG Maxwell 滤波
method_refs.role: Apply MNE Maxwell filtering to continuous MEG using the adapter origin (0, 0, 0.04 m); MEG sensors and a device-to-head transform are required。 Inputs: input: EEG/MEG 原始文件（FIF/EDF/BDF/SET） (file). Registered outputs: results/processed-raw.fif. Fixed invocation options: --operation maxwell.

method_refs.label: dSPM 源定位（需前向模型和噪声协方差）
method_refs.role: Construct an MNE inverse operator from the supplied forward solution and noise covariance, then apply dSPM to continuous data with lambda2=1/9; export source amplitudes, times and vertices。 Inputs: input: EEG/MEG 原始文件（FIF/EDF/BDF/SET） (file); forward: 前向模型 FIF (file); noise_cov: 噪声协方差 FIF (file). Registered outputs: results/source.npz. Fixed invocation options: --operation source.
